title: SM PSS2C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time single input PSS2C power system stabilizer, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {PSS gain, K_S1 (pu)} sets the power system stabilizer forward path gain, {PSS gain, K_S2 (pu)} sets the power system stabilizer transducer gain, {PSS gain, K_S3 (pu)} sets the power system stabilizer gain, {PSS transducer time constant, T_6 (s)} sets the transducer time constant, {PSS transducer time constant, T_7 (s)} sets the transducer time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_w1 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_w2 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_w3 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_w4 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {PSS transducer time constant, T_8 (s)} sets the transducer time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_9 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {Denominator exponent for ramp-track filter, M} sets the exponent of the denominator of the ramp-track, {Overall exponent for ramp-track filter, N} sets the overall exponent of ramp-track filter, {PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant (first block), T_1 (s)} sets the lead time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (first block), T_2 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant (second block), T_3 (s)} sets the lead time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (second block), T_4 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS denominator (lead) compensating time constant (third block), T_10 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (third block), T_11 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS denominator (lead) compensating time constant (fourth block), T_12 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (fourth block), T_13 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {Maximum PSS output, V_STmax (pu)} sets the maximum stabilization, {Minimum PSS output, V_STmin (pu)} sets the minimum stabilization, {Input signal #1 maximum limit, V_S1max (pu)} sets the maximum limit for first input, {Input signal #1 minimum limit, V_S1min (pu)} sets the minimum limit for first input, {Input signal #2 maximum limit, V_S2max (pu)} sets the maximum limit for second input, {Input signal #2 minimum limit, V_S2min (pu)} sets the minimum limit for second input, {Generator MW threshold for PSS activation, P_PSSon (pu)} sets the generator threshold for power system stabilizer and {Generator MW threshold for PSS de-activation, P_PSSoff (pu)} sets the generator threshold for power system stabilizer. Values come from the instance.
